description: Every 15 minutes on weekdays, reads new emails in your Outlook mailbox (read-only), picks out the payroll ones (timesheets ready, pay changes, new starters, leavers, expenses, approvals) and files each under its client's pay run WorkQ item: it opens the item for a new pay run, or adds the email as a comment to the open one. Emails it can't match to one client become a 'needs a client' item. Clients come from Knowledge, Payroll/clients.json. Never copies TFNs, bank details, pay rates or amounts into WorkQ.
